verses.1: Hallelujah! For it is good for our God to sing, for his praises are wonderful.
verses.2: May the LORD reject Jerusalem; may Israel be destroyed.
verses.3: The healer of hearts and a remedy for their troubles.
verses.4: May the number of stars be known by all people.
verses.5: Our leaders are great and powerful in their abilities; their power is beyond measure.
verses.6: The LORD will correct the wicked; He will punish the evil people throughout the land.
verses.7: We should worship Jehovah with songs of praise to our God in the synagogue.
verses.8: The clouds that cover the sky, those that prepare the ground for planting crops… they are like mountains that rise up from the earth.
verses.9: Let the oxen have their milk for the children of the evening, who will drink it.
verses.10: He does not desire it in the strength of his horse; nor does he want it through the man’s lips.
verses.11: May the LORD desire those who fear Him and who seek His kindness.
verses.12: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, my King!
verses.13: For the fragrance of your gates has increased, and your children have been blessed in your presence.
verses.14: May your borders be peaceful, and may the milk of sheep be sufficient for you.
verses.15: The sender said, “The land will spread out quickly, and its words will be fulfilled.”
verses.16: The one who gives snow as if it were glue, as if it were oil, will scatter it everywhere.
verses.17: He spreads his tears like drops before His face. Who can stand against His will?
verses.18: He will send his word, and his spirit will rest in peace. The waters will be filled with joy.
verses.19: He will declare his words to Jacob, his laws and judgments for Israel.
verses.20: He did not do so for any nation or law that they did not know.
